method: programmatic drawing: exact orthographic 2:1 ray casting of boxes/ellipsoids/rods for props, screen-space foliage tufts, heightfield rock splatting, and three screen-space ridges with depth-smoothed facets and dithered valley haze for the backdrop

inputRoles.contract: geometry contract (footprints, backdrop frame and planned horizon)
inputRoles.concept: artboard export; palette samples and arrangement reference only, no pixels copied
inputRoles.landscapeAtlas: palette samples of the existing cypress and rock
inputRoles.campAtlas: palette samples of supplies and road marker; tent and fire in the context preview
inputRoles.monkAtlas: unchanged hero in the context preview
inputRoles.countrySoil: recorded for the ground palette match

seeds: fixed integer salts in the script; random.Random only
